compat.title: Compatible cameras
compat.subtitle: Three BLE backends, one bridge. At a glance:

hardware.note: * See the recording limitation noted above.

cameraNotes: Connect, OSD telemetry, mode readout, record and photo. Can't switch photo/video over BLE - the shutter takes a photo only when the camera is already in Photo mode.
Full control: mode switch, resolution/FPS readout, record and photo. R-SDK protocol with DUML for battery. Pairing via PIN. Tested on the Action 4.
Preset switching, load-by-ID and clock sync from FC GPS time. Bonds on the camera. Recording and OSD telemetry verified on a HERO 12; some features not yet confirmed.
featureLabels: Clock sync from FC GPS time

items.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero
items.detail: ESP32-S3FH4R2 - 4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM, native USB. The board ShutterBridge is built for.

items.name: Betaflight 2025.12 or newer
items.detail: Flight controller running Betaflight 25.12+. Talks to the bridge over MSP; OSD elements draw the camera status.

items.name: A supported action camera
items.detail: A DJI Osmo / Action or a GoPro HERO9 or newer. See the compatibility list above.
